papers.title: The Window Is in the Reasoning: When LLM Agents Decide to Follow Prompt Injections
papers.summary: Uses branching rollouts to measure how much of an LLM agent's decision to follow a prompt injection is already fixed when it reads the untrusted content. For a Qwen3 agent, enabling thinking cuts that share from 0.91 to 0.62, showing the decision forms gradually during reasoning, which challenges runtime monitors and single-run benchmarks.

papers.title: A Survey of Large Language Models
papers.summary: A comprehensive survey of LLMs covering pre-training, adaptation tuning, utilization (prompting, in-context learning, planning), and capacity evaluation. A deep-study reference for the fundamentals behind fine-tuning, RAG, and agents.
